questions.question: "Taxes on lands and buildings" is listed in the _________ list given in the Seventh Schedule in the Constitution of India.
questions.solution: Under the scheme of our Constitution, property tax is leviable by the State Government or a local authority under Entry 49 - "Taxes on lands and buildings" of List II of Schedule VII to the Constitution of India.

questions.question: Gol Gumbaz was designed by?
questions.solution: Gol Gumbaz is the mausoleum of king Mohammed Adil Shah, Sultan of Bijapur. The tomb, located in Bijapur, Karnataka in India, was completed in 1656 by the architect Yaqut of Dabul.

questions.question: The method of soil conservation in which stones, grass, soil are used to build barriers along contours and trenches are made in front of the barriers to collect water is called?
questions.solution: Contour barriers are contour strips which intercept downslope flowing water and soil particles. These barriers slow down the water movement and reduce its erosive force. They also filter out and trap many of the suspended soil particles, keeping them from being washed out of the field. A long term advantage of barriers is that soil tends to build up behind them, creating a terrace effect. Barriers can be classified as live (strips of living plants), dead (rocks, crop residues), or mixed (a combination of the previous two).

questions.question: There are total _________ parliamentary seats (Rajya Sabha constituency) in Maharashtra.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __19.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The Rajya Sabha (which means the "Council of States") is the top house of the Parliament of India. Maharashtra elects 19 seats and they're indirectly elected by using the kingdom legislators of Maharashtra.
 
• The Rajya Sabha or Council of States is the upper house of the Parliament of India.
 
 
• Membership is limited to 250 participants, and the existing Rajya Sabha has 245 individuals.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Rajya Sabha is the higher residence of the Parliament of India.
 
• Gujarat elects eleven seats and they are not directly elected by the kingdom legislators of Gujarat.
 
• There are eighty parliamentary constituencies and 403 legislative meeting constituencies in Uttar Pradesh.
 
• The capability seating ability of the Rajya Sabha is 250 (238 elected, 12 appointed), in step with article 80 of the Indian charter.

questions.question: Which of the following is not among the 3 main classes of Algae?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Gymnosperms.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Marine algae (seaweed) are divided into three groups: Brown Algae (Phaeophyta), Green Algae (Chlorophyta), and Red Algae (Rhodophyta).
 
• **Chlorophyceae**:- These are considered green algae because of the presence of chlorophyll a and b pigments. ... 
 
• **Phaeophyceae**:- Sometimes referred to as brown algae, are mainly marine. ... 
 
• **Rhodophyceae**:- Because of the presence of the red pigment, r-phycoerythrin, the red algae are Rhodophyceae.

questions.question: __________ is defined as the output per unit of variable input.
questions.solution: Average product equals the units of output produced per unit of a factor of production while keeping other factors of production constant.

questions.concept: Science Technology and Inventions, Ecology and Environment
questions.question: The salt concentration (measured as salinity in parts per thousand), is less than ______ % in inland waters.
questions.solution: Salinity is a measure of how much dissolved salts are present in the water. Salinity is either expressed in grams of salt per kilogram of water, or in parts per thousand (ppt, or %). Inland waters are much less saline compared to sea waters.

questions.question: ________ scheme launched by the Central Government aims to improve rural livelihoods and promote rural development and strengthen the Panchayati Raj across the country.

options.text: Gram Uday Se Bharat Uday Abhiyan

questions.solution: 'Gram Uday Se Bharat Uday Abhiyan' (Village Self Governance Campaign) is central government scheme to strengthen Panchayati Raj in villages and ensure social harmony in villages. It was launched on the occasion of 125th birth anniversary of Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar.

questions.question: A ________ deficit is financed by net capital flows from the rest of the world, thus by a capital account surplus.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 1.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• In economics, a country's current account is one of the two components of its balance of payments, the other being the capital account.
 
• A current account deficit is when a country imports more goods, services, and capital than it exports.

questions.question: Sultan Mahmud was a ruler of_____.
questions.solution: The very first ruler in history to assume the title of "Sultan" was Mahmud of Ghazni, founder of the Ghaznavid Empire.

questions.question: In April 2017, to address growing unemployment, which country has abolished the 457 Visa Programme used by thousands of temporary foreign workers, a majority of them Indians?
questions.solution: In April 2017, Australia abolished the 457 Visa Programme used by thousands of temporary foreign workers, a majority of them Indians, to address growing unemployment in their country. Instead, Australia wants to adopt 'Australians first' approach to skilled migration.

questions.question: In male reproductive system, the testes are situated outside the abdominal cavity within a pouch called __________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __Scrotum.__

Scrotum

 
• The testes are situated outside the abdominal cavity within a pouch called the scrotum. 
 
• The scrotum helps in maintaining the low temperature of the testes (2–2.5 °C lower than the normal internal body temperature) necessary for spermatogenesis.

Testicular Lobules

 
• Each testis has about 250 compartments called testicular lobules.

Glands

 
• A gland is an organ that produces and releases substances that perform a specific function in the body.
 
• Two types of Glands-Endocrine, Exocrine.

Seminiferous Tubules

 
• Seminiferous tubules are located in the testicles.
 
• Sperms are produced in Seminiferous Tubules.

**Male Reproductive System**

questions.question: If the force applied on the object is in the direction opposite to the direction of motion, the speed of the object __________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**decreases**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Force:__ It is defined as the push/pull which is required to change the state of the object.
 
• Work: It is the amount of force required to move an object.
 
• Work = Force x Displacement.
 
 
• If the direction of applied force and direction, in which an object moves, are perpendicular to each other, then the work is done = 0 i.e no work is done.
 
• Work is done only when a certain force is applied to an object and the object moves a certain distance in the direction of the applied force. Hence work done is zero when the direction is perpendicular.

questions.question: The SI unit of acceleration is _________.
questions.solution: Calculating acceleration involves dividing velocity by time — or in terms of units, dividing meters per second [m/s] by second [s]. Thus the SI unit of acceleration is the meter per second squared.

questions.question: In Microsoft Excel, the _______ () function returns the smallest value among the values passed as arguments.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __MIN__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

__
 
• The **Excel MIN function** returns the **smallest value** from a supplied **set of numeric values**.
 
• The syntax of the function is:
 
 
• **MIN( number1, [number2], ... )**
 
 
 
• where the **number arguments are one or more numeric values **(or arrays of numeric values), that you want to return the smallest value of.
 
• In current versions of Excel (Excel 2007 & later), you can provide **up to 255 number arguments** to the Min function, but in Excel 2003, the function can only accept up to 30 number arguments.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• If an argument is supplied to the function as a **reference to a cell**, or an array of cells, the Min function will **ignore blank cells**, and **text or logical values** contained within the supplied cell range. However, logical values and text representations of numbers that are **supplied directly to the function** will be included in the calculation.

questions.question: As the river enters the plain it twists and turns forming large bends known as _________.
questions.solution: A meander is one of a series of regular sinuous curves, bends, loops, turns, or windings in the channel of a river, stream, or other watercourse. It is produced by a stream or river swinging from side to side as it flows across its floodplain or shifts its channel within a valley.

questions.question: SAARC Agriculture Centre (SAC) is based in which city?
questions.solution: SAARC Agriculture Centre is the first regional Centre established by the SAARC. The Centre started functioning in 1988 at Dhaka with a mandate for information management, primarily in the field of agriculture and allied discipline.

questions.question: What is formed when Magnesium is burnt?
questions.solution: When magnesium burns, it is actually reacting with oxygen in the air and not with fire. After it finishes burning, a white ash is left behind, a solid that easily breaks up to a powder. This powder is mainly magnesium oxide, MgO.

questions.question: Who discovered Photon?
questions.solution: Albert Einstein proposed a quantum of light (the photon) which behaves like a particle. Einstein's other theories explained the equivalence of mass and energy, the particle-wave duality of photons, the equivalence principle, and special relativity.

questions.question: Who is the winner of 2016-17 Premier League (Football)?
questions.solution: Fixtures for the 2016–17 season were announced on 15 June 2016. Chelsea won their fifth Premier League title, and sixth English title, with two matches to spare following a 1–0 away win over West Bromwich Albion on 12 May.

questions.concept: Art and Culture, Awards and Honours
questions.question: Which of the following was the winner of the Grammy Awards 2016 "Country Song of the Year"?
questions.solution: The Grammy Award for “Best Country Song” has been awarded since 1965. The award is given to the writer(s) of the song, not to the artist. The 2016 award went to Hillary Lindsey, Lori McKenna & Liz Rose for their song ‘Girl Crush’.

questions.question: Fire extinguishers emit which gas?
questions.solution: The CO₂ Extinguisher Cannisters contain carbon dioxide in liquid form, and when the extinguisher is let off the liquid is released into the air neutralising the oxygen that the fire is feeding on, disabling the fires ability to spread.

questions.question: Akbar was _________ years old when he became emperor.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**13 years.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Akbar was one of the mightiest emperors during the Mughal Era.
 
• He was born in October 1542 and died on 27th October 1605.
 
• Akbar was the third Mughal Emperor.
 
• His reign was between 1556-1605 AD.
 
• In **1555,** Humayan died just months after retaking Delhi. Akbar ascended the Mughal throne at the **age of 13** and became **Shahanshah ("King of Kings").** He was crowned in 1556
 
• His regent was** Bayram Khan,** his childhood guardian, and an outstanding warrior/statesman.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• He is known for his liberal religious policies, relationship with Indian kings, conquests, etc.
 
• In 1564, he abolished the jizyah tax levied on non-muslims.
 
• Akbar introduced Mansabdari System in his administration.

questions.question: Sycon (Scypha), Spongilla (Fresh water sponge) and Euspongia (Bath sponge) are examples of which Phylum?
questions.solution: The approximately 5,000 living sponge species are classified in the phylum Porifera, which is composed of three distinct groups, the Hexactinellida (glass sponges), the Demospongia, and the Calcarea (calcareous sponges).
